name: The Deep: Beyond the Reef
summary:
**Dive into The Deep**, an underwater adventure game based on the acclaimed graphic novel series and award-winning Netflix show. Featuring the original voice cast in an all-new adventure, you play as Ant, youngest member of the Nekton family of explorers. 

- Strap into the Vulcan Knight, a prototype aquatic mech
